LESSON: VISUAL MEMORY

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.5: Visual memory

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Visual memory. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you see memory learner should be able to: in visual memory games. around class?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Recall objects, colours and pictures in class memory games enhance visual
2. Talk about what they have seen in class within the class and asked to recall they what they

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Recall objects, colours and pictures in class memory games enhance visual
   In simple words: practise until you can recall objects, colours and pictures in class memory games enhance visual. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Talk about what they have seen in class within the class and asked to recall they what they
   In simple words: practise until you can talk about what they have seen in class within the class and asked to recall they what they. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Visual memory using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Visual memory in the examples.
2. Explain Visual memory to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Visual memory.
4. Show that you can: Recall objects, colours and pictures in class memory games enhance visual

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual memory using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Visual memory important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
